notes:
Summary: Large payments processor evaluating Redwood Private (VPC) for production inference. Primary drivers: rigorous PCI scoping, demonstrable SOC 2+ISO controls, strict data residency for EU merchants, audit log retention for 7 years, KMS/HSM BYOK requirement, dual-region failover.

Key ask from CTO: "We need a VPC control plane with no egress by default, audit trail per-request, and ability to rotate keys with minimal downtime."

Compliance mapping notes (CRM shorthand):
- SOC 2: require control mapping docs (Redwood SOC 2 + SysDesc) + gap assessment. Request: evidence of RBAC, logging, incident response, change control.
- ISO 27001: need statement of applicability + control mapping for Annex A controls relevant to operations and cryptography.
- HIPAA/BAA: non-core but asked since they process some healthcare payments; legal wants BAA template.
- PCI-DSS: want to minimize cardholder data (tokenization out front); however any model input that touches PAN must be out of scope. Need architecture diagram showing tokenization/truncation prior to inference.

Technical requirements (shorthand):
- VPC peering/PrivateLink + no public endpoints for inference.
- KMS: BYOK + HSM-backed key support; key rotation policy; audit log of encryption operations.
- Audit logs: per-request tracing with retention policy (7 years archive to customer-owned S3/GCS).
- Data residency: EU region for EU merchant data; customer can pin models to region.
- Logging + masking: token-level redaction, PII scrub hooks pre-send.

POC scope agreed: 2-week POC (staging VPC), small traffic (100 qps sustained) to validate latency and KV caching behavior, run SOC2-like pen-test and ingest sample EU traffic.

Quote from Head of InfoSec: "We need to see an actual architecture diagram showing custody of keys and where logs land — high level slides aren't enough."

CRM shorthand follow-ups: demo + infra workshop done 2026-02-20 (ff link). Security RFP sent 2026-02-25, response expected 2026-03-08 (delayed). Legal requested BAA 2026-03-03. Internal procurement to provide PO by 2026-04 if SOW approved.

Open items: exact retention SLA (legal wants immutable 7yr), whether Redwood can support HSM tenant-bound keys, PCI scope reduction guidance and diagram, pricing for dedicated throughput under VPC (flat vs usage).
use_case_summary: Processing high-volume payments telemetry: embeddings for behavioral fraud models, real-time classification for routing, and a chat assistant for merchant ops. Strict latency needs for classification path (sub-75ms p99) for in-line risk scoring; less strict for support chat. Cost sensitivity moderate — accept higher unit cost for private VPC + dedicated throughput if PCI/BAA risk reduced.
compliance_mapping_highlights:
Mapping snippet (sales notes):
- SOC 2: Redwood provides SOC 2 Type II report for hosted control plane; customer requires a controls map for Private offering. Action: deliver controls matrix + sample evidence (logs, RBAC snapshots).
- ISO 27001: Provide SoA & major policy documents; propose annual audit cadence.
- HIPAA/BAA: Redwood to provide BAA draft; scope to include only covered functions where PHI transit occurs; prefer customer-side tokenization.
- PCI: Architecture must show tokenization gateway before any model input. Recommend RBC (risk-based conversation) with PCI QSA. Suggest dedicated capacity to reduce shared-tenant scope.

Sales ask: prepare tailored compliance appendix (BAA + PCI scoping + KMS/HSM note) and schedule 90-min security deep dive with infra + legal.
